## Goal
- Build and deploy IVX IA as a **fully owner-controlled AI engineering platform** that can operate, code, test, commit, deploy, monitor, and recover WITHOUT Rork — execute end-to-end, not return only a plan; remove all Rork dependencies from the normal development path; verify and sync all credentials live; **rebuild IVX Owner AI as a REAL senior developer that never reports false completion**

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT call createApp — existing live IVX production; `<new_project>` tag is documented false positive
- Owner Ivan (iperez4242@gmail.com) sole authority; GitHub ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest branch main; Render srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
- Owner approval phrases: CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY, CONFIRM_IVX_FACTORY_MODE, CONFIRM_IVX_SAFE_CODE_PATCH, CONFIRM_IVX_GIT_DEPLOY_OPERATOR, CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE, CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION
- No fake data, no placeholder progress — honest about what can/cannot be done from inside Rork sandbox
- Owner demands honest senior-developer audit — NOT narrative claims; wants real end-to-end proof
- Owner demands Senior Developer answer format: structured TASK ID / STATUS / FILES CHANGED / COMMANDS / TESTS / DEPLOYED proof — NOT product-support summaries
- **Owner's 16-PHASE MANDATE (2026-07-20): rebuild IVX Owner AI as a real senior developer** — (1) 17-state task execution state machine, (2) 11 task-type classification, (3) 18-step senior-developer loop, (4) fix chat loading defect (7 areas A-G), (5) audit likely files, (6) fix false completion reporting, (7) 7-section narrative, (8) context pipeline with retrieval, (9) permanent system prompt rules, (10) separate execution from response, (11) 22-field structured execution record, (12) prevent duplicate worker reports, (13) 15 chat acceptance tests, (14) 6 IVX response tests, (15) 22-item required proof, (16) 16-section final response format
- **CRITICAL**: DEPLOYED means only that a deployment occurred; VERIFIED means acceptance tests passed; a CODE_FIX/UI_FIX/FEATURE task with no code change is NOT complete — must return DEPLOYED_ONLY or NOT_COMPLETED, never DEPLOYED
- GitHub commit API: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `{action: "github_commit_file", input: {path, content, contentEncoding: "gzip-base64", message}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"}` — use `node:zlib` `gzipSync`; pass `.toString('base64')` gzip string as `content`; **use repo-root relative paths (e.g. `backend/services/...`) NOT `/home/user/rork-app/` prefix**
- Render deploy API: same endpoint with `{action: "render_trigger_deploy", input: {}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY"}`
- APK upload: owner-gated `POST /api/ivx/apk/presign-upload` with `{key, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD"}` → returns `uploadUrl` + `publicUrl` → PUT APK to S3 → verify via HEAD; do NOT send `Content-MD5` header; use new filename per version
- Owner token at `/tmp/owner_at` (re-mint via POST `https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` with `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com"}`; token expires ~1h; sandbox resets may wipe `/tmp/owner_at`)
- Correct API host is `https://api.ivxholding.com` (NOT `https://ivxholding.com` which returns HTML)
- Owner-AI POST requires `{"message": "..."}` field (NOT `"prompt"`)
- Dedup: resubmitting same prompt to `/api/ivx/owner-ai` returns existing job — use unique runId in prompt
- Worker job status endpoint returns nested `job` key: `d.get('job')` NOT top-level; result at `job.get('result')`
- `bun test backend/` = 1698 tests / 0 fail (6190 expects); new 16-phase module tests = 86 pass / 0 fail (170 expects); chat merge tests = 18 pass / 0 fail (310 expects)
- Scoped typecheck: `bun x tsc --noEmit` — clean (exit 0) after `bun install`
- Bash commands must complete under 60s or timeout — do NOT loop-poll with sleeps
- Gradle build exceeds 60s — use `setsid` detached background process + poll log
- Clean sandbox has NO `node_modules` — must run `bun install` before gradle build or tsc
- GITHUB_TOKEN provided by owner via secure requestEnvs box; private env — NOT visible in sandbox bash
- Cannot query Supabase directly from sandbox — no SUPABASE env vars in sandbox
- Messages endpoint: correct endpoints are `/messages`, `/api/messages`, `/api/public/messages` (in `backend/hono.ts` lines 4457-4460 and `backend/express-chat-server.ts` lines 531-534)
- Runtime variables API: `GET /api/ivx/runtime-variables` (presence report), `POST /api/ivx/runtime-variables/verify` (run probes, optional `{name}` for single), `POST /api/ivx/runtime-variables/save` (write new value to Render env), `GET /api/ivx/runtime-variables/audit` (cross-scope audit)

## Progress
### Done
- **19-PHASE RORK REMOVAL — ALL 9 TODO TASKS COMPLETED** (prior session): independence report all 4 phases achieved; `currentPhase: final_removal`, `nextPhase: null`

- **FULL LIVE VERIFICATION BATTERY PASSED** (prior session): 3-way SHA parity ✅; Health endpoints 6/6=200; Auth guard ✅; Enterprise modules 8/8=200; Tests 1608 pass/0 fail; Typecheck exit 0; APK v1.4.24(56) LIVE at CloudFront ✅

- **ALL 16 CREDENTIALS SYNCED AND VERIFIED** (prior session): 10 VERIFIED via live HTTP probe; 6 PRESENT_IN_RUNTIME with functional proof; 0 unauthorized, 0 missing

- **SUPABASE ANON VERIFICATION FIX — COMPLETE, DEPLOYED, LIVE VERIFIED** (prior session): Root cause: probe hitting root `/rest/v1/?apikey=KEY` which always 401s for anon; fix: hit real RLS-enabled table `/rest/v1/jv_deals?select=id&limit=1`; commits `3c7c3d83` + `52a73e5c` ✅

- **FACTORY ENGINE BUILT, COMMITTED, DEPLOYED, AND PROVEN LIVE** (prior sessions): `backend/services/ivx-autonomous-coder-factory.ts` — 7 operation kinds; 33 regression tests; commits `e1deca44`+`04f54652`+`8fa36ef0`+`1f628490`+`56a3d061`

- **REAL FACTORY RUNNERS MODULE + WORKER WIRING** (prior sessions): `backend/services/ivx-autonomous-coder-factory-runners.ts` — real migration/dependency/build runners; wired into worker

- **APK v1.4.24(56) BUILT + UPLOADED + VERIFIED LIVE** (prior session): Chat render timeout fix in `expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx`; APK LIVE at `https://ivxholding.com/apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.24.apk` ✅

- **COMPLETION VALIDATOR BUILT, TESTED, COMMITTED, DEPLOYED** (prior session + this session):
  - `backend/services/ivx-completion-validator.ts` — 11 task types, verdicts VERIFIED/DEPLOYED_ONLY/NOT_COMPLETED/BLOCKED/FAILED/NO_CHANGE_REQUIRED
  - `backend/services/ivx-completion-validator.test.ts` — tests covering all task types and verdicts
  - `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-answer-format.ts` — rewired to use validator; DEPLOYED_ONLY for redeploy with no code change
  - `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts` — `taskType` field on `IVXWorkerJobResult`
  - `backend/api/ivx-owner-ai.ts` — system prompt completion-honesty rule
  - Extended this session: added 'explain/analyze/understand/why is/why does' to INVESTIGATION classifier in `classifyTaskType()`
  - Prior HEAD: `8ea2e9582c9a` (completion validator correction deployed)

- **16-PHASE REBUILD — 7 NEW BACKEND MODULES + 8 TEST FILES + 1 REAL CHAT FIX BUILT, COMMITTED, DEPLOYED, 3-WAY PARITY VERIFIED** (this session):
  - **Phase 1**: `backend/services/ivx-task-state-machine.ts` — 17 states with legal transition map; `assertCanTransition()` enforces owner rules (no VERIFIED with empty diff unless external cause, no VERIFIED from /health alone, CODE_CHANGED requires files>0, DEPLOYED requires deployId); `terminalStateForNoWork()` returns BLOCKED/FAILED/NO_CHANGE_REQUIRED; `stageToTaskState()` maps worker stages; `SENIOR_DEVELOPER_LOOP_STEPS` defines 18-step loop; 14 tests
  - **Phase 4D (REAL CHAT CODE FIX)**: `expo/src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/services/ivxChatMessageMerge.ts` — `sortByCreatedAtAscending()` now breaks ties by message id (stable secondary key); previously sorted ONLY by createdAt so equal-timestamp messages reordered after realtime sync; 18 existing chat tests pass
  - **Phase 7+10**: `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-narrative.ts` — `buildSeniorDeveloperNarrative()` reads `IVXExecutionRecord` + verdict, produces 7 sections (DIRECT ANSWER/WHAT WAS WRONG/WHAT I CHANGED/WHY THIS FIX WORKS/TESTS PERFORMED/PRODUCTION PROOF/WHAT IS STILL NOT VERIFIED); `detectForbiddenVaguePhrases()` + `detectInventedActions()` guard against false claims; 7 tests
  - **Phase 8**: `backend/services/ivx-context-pipeline.ts` — `buildContextPipeline()` assembles user request + criteria + preferences + task state + repo + tools + retrieved history + source files + commits + deploy state + logs + schema + failures; keyword extraction + relevance scoring + 12000 token budget; `renderContextPipeline()`; 5 tests
  - **Phase 9**: `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-system-prompt.ts` — `IVX_SENIOR_DEVELOPER_SYSTEM_PROMPT` with all owner-mandated permanent rules
  - **Phase 11**: `backend/services/ivx-execution-record.ts` — `IVXExecutionRecord` with 22 fields; `createExecutionRecord()`/`validateExecutionRecord()`/append helpers; validation rejects VERIFIED with no feature evidence for dev task; 7 tests
  - **Phase 12**: `backend/services/ivx-duplicate-worker-prevention.ts` — `computeIdempotencyKey()`, `createInMemoryLeaseStore()` (acquire/renew/release with TTL), `fingerprintEvidence()`, `checkDuplicateEvidence()`, `normalizeGoalForRetry()`; 8 tests
  - **Phase 13**: `backend/services/ivx-chat-pagination.ts` + test — cursor-based pagination (`encodeCursor`/`decodeCursor`), `INITIAL_PAGE_SIZE=120`/`OLDER_PAGE_SIZE=80`, `stableMessageOrder()`, `deduplicateMessages()`, `prependOlderMessages()`, `mergeRealtimeMessage()`, `isNearBottom()`, `batchRealtimeUpdates()`; 15 acceptance tests
  - **Phase 14**: `backend/services/ivx-response-control.test.ts` — 6 controlled tests (no-code-change NOT VERIFIED, deploy-only DEPLOYED_ONLY, health-pass-feature-fail, code-change-QA-fail, full-evidence VERIFIED, investigation no fabrication)
  - **Commits**: 15 new/modified backend files → commits `09805cdd`→`0d0169e65276`; 1 chat fix → `84a35da42982` = GitHub HEAD `84a35da42982f417c581035ba2277fbc29b8c68c`
  - **Deploy**: `render_trigger_deploy` triggered; runtime propagated to `84a35da42982` (boot 2026-07-20T18:19:15Z, healthy) — 3-way SHA parity MATCH
  - **QA**: full backend 1698 pass/0 fail; new module tests 86 pass/0 fail; chat merge 18 pass/0 fail; 7/7 health endpoints 200

### In Progress
- **WIRING the 7 new standalone modules into the actual worker/answer-format/owner-ai execution path** — modules are built, tested, committed, deployed but NOT yet wired into the runtime execution path; this is the remaining work to make them live

### Blocked
- (none — no technical blockers; wiring is remaining work)

## Key Decisions
- Built the 16-phase modules as standalone, runtime-free, import-safe files to avoid circular dependencies with the worker — same pattern as the completion validator
- Extended `classifyTaskType()` INVESTIGATION branch to recognize "explain/analyze/understand/why is/why does" so technical explanations classify correctly (was matching UI_FIX because "chat" triggered before "explain")
- Fixed `detectInventedActions()` regex to prefer longer extensions (`tsx` before `ts`) to avoid false positive on `chat.tsx` being captured as `chat.ts`
- Phase 4D chat fix was surgical: only `sortByCreatedAtAscending()` in `ivxChatMessageMerge.ts` changed — added id tiebreak to existing createdAt sort; 18 existing tests confirm no regression

## Next Steps
1. **Wire Phase 1 state machine into worker** — import `assertCanTransition()` + `stageToTaskState()` into `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts` to enforce legal state transitions during execution
2. **Wire Phase 7+10 narrative engine** — replace or augment `ivx-senior-developer-answer-format.ts` response generation with `buildSeniorDeveloperNarrative()` from the execution record
3. **Wire Phase 11 execution record** — create and populate `IVXExecutionRecord` during worker execution; pass to narrative engine
4. **Wire Phase 12 duplicate prevention** — import `computeIdempotencyKey()` + `checkDuplicateEvidence()` into worker's `submitOwnerApprovedDevelopmentTask()`
5. **Wire Phase 8 context pipeline** — import `buildContextPipeline()` + `renderContextPipeline()` into `backend/api/ivx-owner-ai.ts` prompt assembly
6. **Wire Phase 9 system prompt** — import `IVX_SENIOR_DEVELOPER_SYSTEM_PROMPT` into owner-ai system prompt injection
7. **Phase 4 full chat pagination** — rewire `expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx` to use cursor-based pagination from `ivx-chat-pagination.ts` for older messages (currently only stable ordering fix is wired)
8. **Device QA** — all 15 chat acceptance tests are pure-logic; on-device QA requires physical Android/iOS device (owner-controlled)

## Critical Context
- **HONEST STATUS: PARTIAL** — 7 new backend modules + 8 test files + 1 real chat code fix are built, tested, committed, deployed, and 3-way parity verified at HEAD `84a35da42982`, BUT the modules are STANDALONE and NOT yet wired into the actual worker/answer-format/owner-ai execution path
- The ONLY real code change to an EXISTING runtime file is the Phase 4D stable ordering fix in `expo/src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/services/ivxChatMessageMerge.ts`
- The completion validator (prior session) IS wired into the actual answer-format and IS live — it correctly returns DEPLOYED_ONLY for redeploy-only tasks
- Render deploy sometimes only picks up the first commit in a batch — may need to trigger a fresh `render_trigger_deploy` after multiple commits
- Owner token expires ~1h — re-mint if commits fail with auth errors
